messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGER #3892 — inference-prod (us-west-2) high 5xx rate detected. Started 2024-11-05T02:16:07Z. Severity: P2. Bridge: https://meet.example/3892

alex: I'm oncall — joining bridge now. first step: triage logs, check model rollout.

sara: on bridge. seeing timeout spikes and increased queue length on frontend workers. grafana: https://grafana.example/d/abc/inference-prod-overview (span 02:00-02:20)

alex: ack. rolling back model rollout to v1.8 to eliminate model-change hypothesis. running:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=12
```

infra-bot: Rollback triggered by alex at 02:22Z. New image tag set to r1.8. Confirming pod health.

alex: rollback complete at 02:25Z. error rate down from ~7.8% to ~1.4% within 3m. still monitoring.

maria: support note — two customers (acme-inc, beta-saas) reported intermittent 504s during window 02:10-02:28. one customer retried and saw degraded throughput. No data loss reported.

jamie: collected kernel logs and pod oom events: s3://redwood-incident-archive/3892/kernel-logs.tar.gz. saw elevated reconnects to redis around 02:12-02:18.

alex: thanks. quick mitigation summary for execs: rollback fixed most errors, cause suspected to be model binary interaction with batcher under a specific seq-len distribution. planning postmortem.

rachel: adding security check — verified no unexpected outbound connections in the timeframe. no indicators of compromise.

alex: proposed postmortem schedule: async draft by EOD today, sync review tomorrow 11:00 PT, owners: alex (RCA write), jamie (infra evidence), rachel (sec review), maria (customer impact). action tracking in board: https://boards.example/incident-3892

maria: available for sync tomorrow, will collect customer support transcripts and impact calc (est lost requests).

jamie: I'll attach traces and kernel backtraces to the draft. ETA EOD. linking trace IDs: trace-9a7 and trace-9a8.

alex: creating initial RCA draft now. linking artifact: s3://redwood-incident-archive/3892/rca-draft.md

alex: DRAFT (excerpt)
```
Timeline:
- 02:08Z: Traffic spike, queue length ++
- 02:10Z: Error rate rises (5xx) on inference-prod
- 02:12Z: Rapid reconnects to redis observed
- 02:15Z: Canary model rollout in prod completed (v2.1)
- 02:18Z: Error rate peaks ~7.8%
- 02:22Z: Oncall rollback to v1.8 initiated
- 02:25Z: Rollback complete; error rate drops to ~1.4%
Potential contributing factors:
- Model change (v2.1) increased latency variance for long sequences
- Batcher configuration not handling higher tail latency
- Autoscaler decision window allowing sudden burst to overload workers

Immediate actions taken:
- Rollback to v1.8
- Increased observability on kv-cache hits/misses
- Customer notifications sent by support
```

alex: asking reviewers to comment inline on the draft. particularly want jamie and infra team to validate redis/oom timeline and rachel on security findings.

rachel: quick comment — under contributing factors, call out the autoscaler cooldown being 60s which allowed nodes to terminate and come back too slowly. suggest adding mitigation: lower cooldown and warmup pod strategy.

jamie: confirmed redis reconnects correlate with pod restarts from autoscaler. attaching pod-start logs: s3://redwood-incident-archive/3892/pod-starts.log

maria: added customer impact paragraph to draft and included support ticket IDs: #4729, #4731. estimate: ~1200 failed requests total during window, highest impact for two enterprise tenants.

alex: updated draft with jamie and maria's inputs. requesting peer review sign-off. please respond with "ack" or list followups.

rachel: ack — I approve the security section. I recommend tracking the autoscaler cooldown change as a P0 follow-up.

jamie: ack — infra will own autoscaler tune and pod warmup test. plan: run canary load test w/ v2.1 on staging tomorrow. owner: jamie. due: +3 days.

maria: ack — support will complete customer outreach summary and include compensation rec notes. owner: maria. due: +2 days.

alex: assigning actions in the board and scheduling the sync. I'll finalize the RCA for review after any last comments by EOD.

oncall-bot: Postmortem scheduled: sync 2024-11-06 18:00Z. RCA draft URL: s3://redwood-incident-archive/3892/rca-draft.md. Actions recorded to board https://boards.example/incident-3892/actions

alex: thanks everyone. closing bridge and switching to writeup mode. any late comments here and I'll incorporate before EOD.
